text:
The core never reaches its intended operating point: Vref is 0.43 V, power is low (~0.24 µA per branch) and line regulation is above 1 V/V. The stacked PMOS–NMOS–BJT core likely lacks headroom at 1.8 V, because NMOS body effect raises Vgs and the PMOS Vsg is large.

The fix is to swap the core for a weak-inversion NMOS β-multiplier, which needs only Vsg_p + Vgs_n. R1 is now sized from the LUT-solved ΔVgs instead of the `UT·ln(N)` estimate. I keep the Q3 + R2/R3 output leg. I also replace the start-up with an NMOS detector driven by Vref, which pulls `sx` low once Vref is up.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Core stuck at low/false state (vref 0.43, low power, line_reg>1): stacked PMOS+body-effected NMOS+BJT lacks headroom. Replace with weak-inversion NMOS beta-multiplier (R1 from LUT-solved dVgs), keep Q3 divider output leg, start-up detector gated by vref."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":    (0.4e-6, 0.25e-6, 0.6e-6),   # core branch / output current
    "VP":   (0.55, 0.40, 0.70),          # PTAT voltage I*R2 at 27C
    "a":    (0.72, 0.62, 0.90),          # I*R3 (sets divider k and Q3 current)
    "Lp":   (6.0, 2.0, 10.0),            # PMOS mirror length
    "Ln":   (4.0, 1.0, 8.0),             # NMOS beta-multiplier length
    "gmp":  (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),           # PMOS gm/Id
    "gmn":  (20.0, 14.0, 25.0),          # NMOS gm/Id (weak inversion)
    "Cg":   (1e-12, 0.2e-12, 3e-12),     # PMOS gate-to-vdd cap (PSRR)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = p["I"]; K = 8
    Ln = p["Ln"]
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmn"], Ln, I, vds=0.4)
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmn"], Ln, K * I, vds=0.9, vsb=0.08)   # W ~ K*W1
    W2 = m2.W
    vg = m1.vgs
    # solve source voltage of M2 (degenerated, K x wider) carrying I
    vs = 0.08
    for _ in range(12):
        lo, hi = 0.0, vg
        for _ in range(40):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            idm = lut.op("n", W2, Ln, mid, max(1.0 - vs, 0.1), vs)["Id"]
            if idm > I:
                hi = mid
            else:
                lo = mid
        vgs2 = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        vs_new = max(vg - vgs2, 0.02)
        vs = 0.5 * vs + 0.5 * vs_new
    R1 = vs / I
    R2 = p["VP"] / I
    R3 = p["a"] / I

    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmp"], p["Lp"], I, vds=0.8)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # beta-multiplier PTAT core
    n.dev("M3", "na", "nb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M4", "nb", "nb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M1", "na", "na", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "nb", "na", "x2", "vss", m2, m=K)
    n.R("R1", "x2", "vss", R1)
    n.C("CG", "nb", "vdd", p["Cg"])
    # output leg: vref = R3/(R2+R3) * (Veb3 + I*R2)
    n.dev("M5", "vref", "nb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.R("R3", "vref", "vss", R3)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=1)
    # start-up: weak always-on pull-up on sx; NMOS detector gated by vref pulls sx low when running.
    n.M("MS2a", "sx1", "vss", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("MS2b", "sx", "vss", "sx1", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("MS3", "sx", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 4.0, 0.5)
    n.M("MS", "nb", "sx", "na", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 2.0)
    n.C("CS", "sx", "vss", 20e-15)

    # predictions
    veb = lambda i: 0.76 + UT * math.log(max(i, 1e-12) / 10e-6)
    iq3 = 0.1 * I; v3 = veb(iq3)
    for _ in range(30):
        iq3 = max((I * R3 - v3) / (R2 + R3), 1e-10); v3 = veb(iq3)
    k = R3 / (R2 + R3)
    vref = k * (v3 + I * R2)
    slope = k * (-2.0e-3 + I * R2 / 300.15)
    tc = abs(slope) / vref * 1e6 + 200
    rout = R2 * R3 / (R2 + R3)
    dv = mp.gds * rout * 2.0
    psrr = -db(max(dv, 1e-6))
    power = 1.8 * (3 * I + 0.15e-6)
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc, "line_reg": dv,
               "power": power, "psrr_1k": psrr, "startup_ok": 1}
```
